### Detailed Proof Plan

1. Introduce `p`, `q` and the hypothesis `h : p ∧ q`.
2. The pair `⟨h.2, h.1⟩` proves `q ∧ p`.

```lean4
/-! The tutorial node (D-27): permanently open, off-ledger. Lean core only. -/

theorem OpnProp.and_swap : ∀ p q : Prop, p ∧ q → q ∧ p := by
  intro p q h
  exact ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
```
